description: 300 fictional English news headlines for offline sentiment evaluation: 100 Positive, 100 Negative, and 100 Neutral; 10 examples per label in each of 10 topics.
annotation_method: AI-authored semantic polarity labels assigned independently of the classifier. These are intended labels requiring human review, not validated ground truth.
intended_use: Smoke evaluation and error analysis only. Headlines are fictional and must not be published as real news. This is not a representative benchmark or a measure of full-article sentiment accuracy.
